title: Job descriptions are your BEST job search friend 🔎
description:
When you're applying to jobs the job description is your BEST FRIEND. A job description is the whole guide for what the company wants from who they hire and you need to be referencing it to make edits to your resume. If you're applying to a job that lists a particular set of programs you'll be using you need to list them. If it lists a set of hard skills important to the job you need to list them. #jobdescription #jobsearch #jobsearching #resumetips #resume
